narr: An upper level trough moved over a warm, moist airmass and generated thunderstorms. Some of these storms produced locally heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. A Certified Consulting Meteorologist in Del Rio reported that a van was stranded in flood water up to the bottom of its doors at Mary Lou Dr. and Kings Way.
lsr: STALLED VAN AT MARY LOU DRIVE AND KINGS WAY WITH WATER UP TO THE BOTTOM OF THE DOORS. RELAYED BY A CERTIFIED CONSULTING METEOROLOGIST.
